description: Defines a PHP class 'ModuleScreen' used as a data transfer object (DTO) within the OrangeHRM system, representing a module and screen configuration with support for overridden values.

classes.name: ModuleScreen
classes.description: A data transfer object that encapsulates the module and screen identifiers, including overridden variants, used within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ModuleScreen object with optional module and screen identifiers, and sets override values accordingly.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module identifier and conditionally updates the overridden module value.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen identifier and conditionally updates the overridden screen value.
